paper.title: Search Self-play: Pushing the Frontier of Agent Capability without Supervision
paper.central_claim: SSP co-trains a search question proposer and solver with RAG-validated self-generated questions to improve deep-search agent weights without manually annotated task queries.

provenance.notes: Configured agent model type sonnet; runtime states gpt-6.1-sol. No independently available model receipt or session identifier; no probing performed.

sections_read: Appendices A–E including complete prompts, examples and hacking cases

evidence.support_explanation: The solver and proposer update model parameters, not a retained harness.
Role prompts are supplied inputs; no prompt editing or retention loop is evaluated.

evidence.quote: but the replay buffer is cleared every 10 training steps
evidence.support_explanation: Temporary replay data supports weight training rather than evaluated non-weight improvement.

signatures.information: seed answers from public training sets; proposer search documents; solver correctness and RAG validation
signatures.operation: generate/filter questions; collect solver rollouts; GRPO solver and REINFORCE proposer updates
signatures.conditions: verified QA plus format and RAG filtering
signatures.feedback: answer-equivalence LLM judge and solver failure fraction
signatures.persistence: model checkpoints; replay buffer cleared every 10 steps
signatures.later_use: trained search policy answers held-out QA
signatures.failure_boundary: ambiguous questions; punitive proposer reward can collapse training

gap.author_gap: annotated QA scarcity and fixed offline synthesis difficulty
gap.checked_gap: Paper presents adaptive validated training data, but evaluated improvement is parameter learning.
lineage: prior proposer-solver self-play; references inside fixed paper only
gap.residue: validity of ambiguous questions and training expense
gap.method_response: RAG-validity constraint plus opposing proposer/solver rewards
unresolved: Independent original texts of named neighbors not included; no external novelty verification.

matches.reason: Manufactures and filters supervision for parameter training; C26 comparative-credit tactic is less precise than parent-level match, so sub=null.

rs_pattern.reason: Pattern execution does not override scope.

condition_checks.reason: RAG validates retrieved evidence but same-family judgments retain ambiguity risk.
Seven QA evaluation benchmarks and fixed-opponent controls.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Generate and validate QA, then co-train roles.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: H22 boundary taxonomy is descriptively applicable but pure weight self-play remains excluded under A3.

expectations.reason: RAG and noise mitigate ambiguity but are not independent factual certification.

claims.text: SSP improves search-agent capability via co-evolution.
claims.result: author-reported QA gains; not a retained harness effect
claims.counterevidence: Scope exclusion does not contest the weight-training finding.
claims.allowed_conclusion: A self-play weight-training method, not demonstrated non-weight RSI.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author reports improved QA from updated weights; no evidence of retained non-weight improvement.
unresolved: No independent replication; nearest-neighbor originals unavailable.

reason: Frozen A3: both evaluated update object and resulting agent improvement are model weights. Fixed prompts, RAG filters and temporary replay buffer are training machinery; no non-weight edit is selected, retained and evaluated on later tasks.
rationale: SSP是RAG校验的提问者—解题者权重共训练。固定提示与临时重放缓冲区不是被评估的留存改动；按A3排除，不以低分代替范围裁定。
